title: Thailand Visa-Free 30 Days for UK Citizens | TDAC Help
description: Thailand visa-free travel for British citizens: 30 days for tourism since September 2026, the Digital Arrival Card, extensions and when you need a visa.
intro: British passport holders can visit Thailand without a visa for up to 30 days for tourism. You still need to complete the free Thailand Digital Arrival Card before you travel. We prepare your Thailand visa-free application and check every detail before it is submitted.

sections.heading: Thailand visa-free stays since September 2026
sections.text: Since 15 September 2026, British and Irish passport holders can enter Thailand without a visa for up to 30 days, for tourism only. Before then, the visa-free stay was 60 days. Travellers who entered before the change keep the stay they were given.

sections.heading: Extending a visa-free stay
sections.text: A visa-exempt stay can usually be extended once by up to 30 days at a Thai immigration office in Thailand, for a fee. If you know before you travel that you'll stay longer than 30 days, a Tourist e-Visa is usually the better choice.

sections.heading: What you need at the border
sections.text: Have a passport valid for at least 6 months, your completed Thailand Digital Arrival Card, proof of onward or return travel, and details of where you'll stay. Immigration officers can ask to see proof of funds.

sections.heading: Thailand visa-free help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers and businesses across the UK. We check the rules for your passport, prepare your application and keep you updated until it's decided.

faqs.q: How long can British citizens stay in Thailand without a visa?
faqs.a: Up to 30 days for tourism, since 15 September 2026.

faqs.q: Can I do business on visa-free entry?
faqs.a: No. The visa exemption now covers tourism only. Business trips need a visa.

faqs.q: How long does a Thailand visa-free take?
faqs.a: Processing times vary with the authority and the time of year. Apply as early as you can, and don’t book non-refundable travel until your visa or authorisation is approved.

faqs.q: Can you help with my Thailand visa-free application?
faqs.a: Yes. We check which visa fits your trip, prepare your Thailand visa-free application and documents, and keep you updated. Contact us or call 0161 956 2003.
